lines.text: breaking your GTA 6 character for good? Reports say it's possible.
GTA 6 has a Criminal Profile, and it grades how you commit crimes, not how many.
The reported states are Professional, Aggressive, Violent, and Psycho.
Rockstar's Rob Nelson says the game doesn't force you to play Professional.
But go too far, and the profile logo reportedly starts to crack,
One report says that state stays locked for the rest of your playthrough.
Other outlets hedge on the exact triggers, and no formula is published.
